name: fetch
run: git -C /opt/roam-hub/src fetch -q origin main && echo new=$(git -C /opt/roam-hub/src rev-parse --short=12 origin/main) deployed=$(cat /opt/roam-hub/DEPLOYED_SHA 2>/dev/null || echo none)

name: smoke
run: cd /opt/roam-hub/src && SMOKEDB=$(mktemp -u /tmp/smoke-XXXX.db) && (RHUB_DB=$SMOKEDB timeout 5 ./roam-hub serve 8890 &) && sleep 2 && curl -sf localhost:8890/_health

name: swap-restart
run: install -m755 /opt/roam-hub/src/roam-hub /opt/roam-hub/roam-hub.new && cp /opt/roam-hub/roam-hub /opt/roam-hub/roam-hub.prev && mv -f /opt/roam-hub/roam-hub.new /opt/roam-hub/roam-hub && cmp -s /opt/roam-hub/src/roam-hub /opt/roam-hub/roam-hub && sudo systemctl restart roam-hub

name: health-or-rollback
run: sleep 3; ok=0; for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:8810/_health > /dev/null && ok=1 && break; sleep 2; done; if [ $ok = 1 ]; then echo healthy; else bash /opt/roam-hub/rollback.sh; exit 1; fi
